title: The Shawshank Redemption (1994)
description: Two imprisoned men bond over a number of years, finding solace and eventual redemption through acts of common decency.

title: The Godfather (1972)
description: The aging patriarch of an organized crime dynasty transfers control of his clandestine empire to his reluctant son.

title: The Dark Knight (2008)
description: When the menace known as the Joker wreaks havoc and chaos on the people of Gotham, Batman must accept one of the greatest psychological and physical tests of his ability to fight injustice.

title: Pulp Fiction (1994)
description: The lives of two mob hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife, and a pair of diner bandits intertwine in four tales of violence and redemption.

title: Forrest Gump (1994)
description: The presidencies of Kennedy and Johnson, the events of Vietnam, Watergate, and other historical events unfold from the perspective of an Alabama man with an IQ of 75.

title: The Matrix (1999)
description: A computer programmer discovers that his reality is a simulation created by machines, and joins a rebellion to break free.

title: Goodfellas (1990)
description: The story of Henry Hill and his life in the mob, covering his relationship with his wife Karen and his mob partners Jimmy Conway and Tommy DeVito.

title: The Silence of the Lambs (1991)
description: A young F.B.I. cadet must receive the help of an incarcerated and manipulative cannibal killer to help catch another serial killer.

title: Saving Private Ryan (1998)
description: Following the Normandy Landings, a group of U.S. soldiers go behind enemy lines to retrieve a paratrooper whose brothers have been killed in action.

title: The Lion King (1994)
description: A young lion prince is cast out of his pride by his cruel uncle, who claims he killed his father. He returns years later to reclaim his throne.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning (2015)
description: In ancient India, a brave warrior is raised by a tribal community and discovers his true identity to avenge his mother's death and fulfill his destiny.

title: Baahubali 2: The Conclusion (2017)
description: The epic conclusion to the Baahubali saga, revealing the secrets of the past and culminating in a colossal war for the throne of Mahishmati.

title: RRR (2022)
description: Two legendary revolutionaries, Alluri Sitarama Raju and Komaram Bheem, embark on a daring mission to fight against British colonial rule.

title: Pushpa: The Rise (2021)
description: A laborer in the red sandalwood smuggling trade rises through the ranks to become the kingpin, facing challenges from rivals and the law.

title: KGF: Chapter 2 (2022)
description: The epic conclusion of the KGF saga, where Rocky Bhai faces his greatest challenges to protect his empire and fulfill his mother's promise.

title: 3 Idiots (2009)
description: Two friends search for their long-lost college buddy, who is a genius and a prankster. They revisit their college days and discover the value of friendship and following one's passion.

title: Dangal (2016)
description: Based on the true story of Mahavir Singh Phogat, who trained his daughters to become world-class wrestlers, defying societal norms in rural India.

title: PK (2014)
description: An alien stranded on Earth questions human beliefs and customs, leading to a hilarious and thought-provoking satire on religion and society.

title: Arjun Reddy (2017)
description: A brilliant but self-destructive surgeon spirals into alcoholism and rage after a breakup with his girlfriend. A raw, intense, and controversial love story.

description: A mistaken delivery in Mumbai's lunchbox delivery system connects a young housewife to a lonely widower, leading to a unique relationship through notes in the lunchbox.

title: Gangs of Wasseypur (2012)
description: A clash between two families unfolds over three generations in the coal-rich town of Wasseypur, as revenge and power struggles escalate.

title: Barfi! (2012)
description: Three friends in 1970s India navigate love, friendship, and life's challenges, with one of them being a deaf-mute young man who spreads joy wherever he goes.

title: Queen (2014)
description: After her fiancé calls off their wedding, a young woman from Delhi decides to go on her honeymoon alone to Paris and Amsterdam, discovering herself along the way.

title: Andhadhun (2018)
description: A blind pianist's life takes a dark turn when he becomes embroiled in a series of crimes. A thrilling ride with unexpected twists and turns.

title: Tumbbad (2018)
description: A man searches for hidden treasure in a cursed village, but must confront the monstrous consequences of his greed across generations.

title: Article 15 (2019)
description: A police officer in rural India investigates a series of caste-based crimes, confronting deep-rooted prejudice and systemic injustice.

title: Super Deluxe (2019)
description: An anthology film with intersecting stories about a transgender woman, a teenage boy, a wife, and a husband returning home, all set in a single night.

title: Eega (2012)
description: A murdered man is reincarnated as a housefly and seeks revenge on his killer, protecting the woman he loves in this innovative and entertaining film.

title: Drishyam (2013)
description: A simple cable operator uses his wits and movie knowledge to protect his family when his daughter accidentally kills a police officer's son.

title: Udaan (2010)

title: The Sky Is Pink (2019)

title: October (2018)
description: A hotel management student's life changes when a co-worker falls from a balcony, leading him to discover the meaning of love, responsibility, and human connection.

title: Dear Zindagi (2016)
description: A young cinematographer seeks advice from an unconventional therapist to overcome her fears and relationship issues, finding healing and self-discovery.

title: Me Before You (2016)
description: A young woman takes a job caring for a wealthy man who is paralyzed from the neck down, and their relationship blossoms into an unexpected love story.

title: La La Land (2016)
description: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love while pursuing their dreams in Los Angeles, facing the challenges of balancing art and relationships.

title: The Social Network (2010)
description: The story of the founding of Facebook and the legal battles that followed.

title: The Wolf of Wall Street (2013)
description: The true story of Jordan Belfort's rise and fall as a stockbroker.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road (2015)
description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel (2014)
description: A writer encounters the owner of an aging European hotel.

title: Dune (2021)
description: A young man with a special destiny must navigate a dangerous desert planet.
